title: ジャパンカップの後に・“皇帝”推参

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio does a splendid job winning the Japan Cup, a race filled with some of the toughest competitors around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, she heads to the student council office to meet with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After she arrives, Symboli Rudolf tells her that she desires to race with the Monarch Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The showdown shall be at the biggest race of them all, the Arima Kinen! Teio's most longed-for match is about to become a reality!
